# Settings profiles

On the settings page I pick a profile for my game: Default (the config file) or one I saved. My game follows that profile until I change a setting in it. Profiles are kept in my X4 profile, so every save sees the same list. Flows: docs/specs/settings-profiles-flows.md.

Source: [`tests/game/features/settings-profiles.feature`](../../tests/game/features/settings-profiles.feature) · Spec: [`docs/specs/settings-profiles.md`](../specs/settings-profiles.md)

## Scenarios

### A new game is on the profile for new games

**Automated:** in game `settings_seed_from_defaults`

```gherkin
  Given my profile for new games is "Hard mode", with "intact when marines claim" off
  And the config file has it on
  When I start a new game
  Then the game is on "Hard mode"
  And "intact when marines claim" is off
```

### Changing a setting stops the game following its profile

**Automated:** in game `settings_change_marks_modified`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode"
  When I turn a setting on in it
  Then the game uses the new value at once
  And it is marked as changed
  And the "Hard mode" profile is unchanged
  When I save the changes into "Hard mode"
  Then the game is no longer marked as changed
```

### A game on a profile picks up changes saved into it from another game

**Automated:** in game `settings_linked_follows_profile`

```gherkin
  Given game B is on "Hard mode" with no changes, and was saved
  And in game C I saved changes into "Hard mode"
  When I load game B
  Then it uses Hard mode's new values
```

### A game saved with changes is on its own settings when loaded again

**Automated:** in game `settings_saved_modified_loads_as_none`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode" with a changed setting, saved
  When I load it
  Then it is on "None (custom settings)"
  And it uses the values it had when it was saved, whatever "Hard mode" holds now
```

### A game whose profile is gone keeps its values

**Automated:** in game `settings_linked_profile_gone`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode", saved
  And "Hard mode" no longer exists (deleted, or the save is on another PC)
  When I load the game
  Then it is on "None (custom settings)"
  And it uses the values it had when it was saved
```

### Choosing a profile loads it and clears changes

**Automated:** in game `settings_choose_profile_clears_changes`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode" with a changed setting
  When I choose "Easy mode" and confirm
  Then the game is on "Easy mode" with no changes
  And it uses the config file's values with Easy mode's on top
```

### Choosing Default brings back the config file's values

**Automated:** in game `settings_choose_default`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode" with a changed setting
  When I choose "Default" and confirm
  Then the game is on "Default" with no changes
  And it uses the config file's values
```

### An unknown or invalid setting in a profile keeps its config value

**Automated:** in game `settings_profile_invalid_values`

```gherkin
  Given "Hard mode" has "intact when marines claim" set to "never" and a setting the mod doesn't have
  When a game loads "Hard mode"
  Then "intact when marines claim" has its config value
  And the unknown setting is ignored
  And the "Hard mode" profile is not changed
```

### A changed game shows the profile with a star, and can save into it

**Automated:** unit tests `test_toggling_marks_a_profile_modified_but_not_none`, `test_profile_dropdown_marks_unsaved_changes_and_offers_none_only_when_on_it`, `test_save_changes_only_into_a_saved_profile_with_changes`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode"
  When I change a setting
  Then the Profile dropdown shows "Hard mode *"
  And "Save changes to 'Hard mode'" is enabled
  When I press it
  Then "Hard mode" has the game's values
  And the dropdown shows "Hard mode" and the button is disabled again
```

### Turning a changed setting back removes the star

**Automated:** unit tests `test_turning_a_setting_back_clears_the_mark`, `test_saved_changes_become_the_new_baseline`; in game `settings_undo_clears_modified`

```gherkin
  Given a game on "Hard mode" with a setting changed, showing "Hard mode *"
  When I turn that setting back to Hard mode's value
  Then the dropdown shows "Hard mode" without the star
  And "Save changes to 'Hard mode'" is disabled
  And after saving changes into "Hard mode", the saved values are what the star compares against
```

```gherkin
  When I change a setting, choose a profile, save changes, save a new profile, choose the profile for new games or delete a profile

```
